blogPosts.title: How to Measure SEO Performance After Hiring an Agency
blogPosts.desc: Learn the key metrics, tools, and reporting frameworks to track SEO performance and ensure your agency delivers compounding ROI.
takeaways: Focus on Organic Revenue and Qualified Leads, not just vanity keyword rankings.
Track Google Search Console Impression-to-Click Conversion Ratios weekly.
Demand monthly transparent attribution reports showing bottom-line ROI.
Monitor technical site health and Core Web Vitals alongside content growth.

content.heading: The Real Metrics That Matter in Modern Agency Partnerships
content.text: When investing in professional SEO services, tracking the right KPIs is crucial to evaluating campaign success. Too many business owners fall into the trap of monitoring superficial vanity metrics—like tracking rankings for non-commercial search terms—while ignoring the metrics that actually impact the bottom line.

content.heading: 1. Organic Conversion Rate and Qualified Lead Volume
content.text: Rankings are simply a gateway. The true indicator of effective SEO is whether search traffic converts into inbound phone calls, form submissions, and booked consultations. High-performing agencies optimize for high-intent transactional keywords that bring in ready-to-buy customers.

content.heading: 2. Google Search Console & Non-Branded Organic Impressions
content.text: Before conversions spike, non-branded search impressions provide an early diagnostic signal of search authority growth. A healthy organic strategy consistently expands your impression footprint across non-branded commercial search queries.

content.heading: 3. Technical Site Health & Core Web Vitals
content.text: Technical foundation dictates organic indexation speed and ranking stability. A top-tier SEO partner ensures page load times remain under 1.8 seconds, mobile responsiveness is flawless, and clean XML sitemap indexing is maintained without crawl errors.

blogPosts.title: Questions to Ask Before Hiring an SEO Agency
blogPosts.desc: Hiring the right SEO agency can make or break your business growth. Here are the 10 must-ask questions before signing.
takeaways: Ask for verified case studies in your specific industry niche.
Understand their exact link-building and content production processes.
Ensure full ownership of all analytics accounts, content, and site assets.
Avoid agencies promising guaranteed #1 rankings overnight.

content.heading: Navigating the Search Agency Vetting Process
content.text: Partnering with an SEO agency is a strategic investment in your market share. To separate elite growth agencies from low-quality providers, asking precise technical and operational questions during pre-contract discovery is essential.

content.heading: Key Vetting Criteria & Questions to Ask
content.text:
1. Can you share verified case studies with bottom-line revenue metrics?
2. What is your process for technical site audits and speed optimization?
3. How do you earn high-authority backlinks without risky black-hat tactics?
4. Will our team retain 100% ownership of all created content and site assets?

content.heading: Dominating Local Search for Emergency HVAC Services
content.text: For HVAC contractors, ranking in the Google Map Pack during peak summer heatwaves or winter freezes directly determines business success. Local homeowners search with high intent when heating or AC systems fail.

content.heading: Core HVAC Search Tactics
content.text:
1. Claim and optimize Google Business Profile categories for AC Repair & Furnace Installation.
2. Add GEO-targeted service area pages with local customer testimonials.
3. Publish transparent pricing guides to capture early-stage research queries.
